items.title: experiment tool sends `type`; handler dispatches on `action`, so the requested operation is ignored
items.evidence: Fixed in c657ab2. The request struct carries the action; the handler dispatches on it. Proof: tests/tool_contract.rs::experiment_runs_the_requested_action.

items.title: hypothesis tool sends no `action`; handler dispatches on `action` and falls through to `test`
items.evidence: Fixed in c657ab2. Same shape. Proof: tests/tool_contract.rs::hypothesis_runs_the_requested_action.

items.title: detect_anomaly tool sends `type`; handler dispatches on `action` and falls through to `detect`
items.evidence: Fixed in c657ab2. Same shape. Proof: tests/tool_contract.rs::detect_anomaly_analyses_the_live_game_with_the_given_thresholds.

items.title: stress_test tool sends `type`; handler dispatches on `action` and falls through to `run`
items.evidence: Fixed in c657ab2. Same shape. Proof: tests/tool_contract.rs::stress_test_runs_the_requested_test_type.

items.title: hypothesis measures hard-coded constants: 16.67 ms frame time, 100 entities, 500 components, 1024 MB, 50% CPU
items.evidence: Fixed in 0e138cc. Entity and component counts are measured from the game; the other three are refused with a reason. Proof: tests/hypothesis_metrics.rs (4 tests).

items.title: replay record captures nothing: entity and event fetching are TODO and return empty

must_fix.evidence: src/recording_system.rs:328-350, both fetchers return an empty collection

items.evidence: Fixed in e1e0517. Entity states are recorded; events are not observable over BRP, so a frame carries events_not_captured. Two more bugs found while proving it: the dropped first frame and its duplication. Proof: tests/replay_recording.rs (3 tests).

items.title: server instructions tell agents to use `hypothesis`/`experiment`/`stress_test`/`replay` for inspecting and re-running the game, but those tools mislead
items.evidence: Fixed in ef3025c. The instructions now name the fields each tool needs. Proof: tests/instructions.rs (3 tests).

items.title: CLAUDE.md says a screenshot fails loudly without DebugCaptureTarget; the code silently falls back to window capture
items.evidence: Fixed in 00b98c8. CLAUDE.md now says the fallback is to window capture, which is weaker than offscreen but not focus-stealing. Proof: tests/docs_drift.rs::claude_md_does_not_claim_the_screenshot_refuses_to_fall_back.

items.title: lib.rs crate docs say Bevy 0.12 with feature `bevy_remote_protocol`; the crate is on Bevy 0.20
items.evidence: Fixed in 00b98c8. src/lib.rs names Bevy 0.20. The example is a text block, because it belongs to the game crate and this crate does not depend on bevy by default. Proof: tests/docs_drift.rs::the_docs_name_the_bevy_version_the_crate_uses.

items.title: README and book/SCREENSHOT_SETUP.md tell users to hand-register `bevy_debugger/screenshot`, which now double-adds RemotePlugin and panics
items.evidence: Fixed in 00b98c8. The README and the book use the plugin and say not to add a second RemotePlugin. Proof: tests/docs_drift.rs::the_readme_does_not_tell_the_reader_to_register_a_method_the_plugin_registers and the_book_ variant.
